visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black t-shirt holds a camera in a selfie perspective within a brightly lit shopping mall, speaking directly to the lens while a woman with dark hair and bangs stands closely behind his shoulder. (2) The scene cuts to a dark wall covered in multiple glowing digital monitors of various sizes, each displaying different action-oriented gameplay footage from fantasy video games, including logos like Nintendo 3DS. (3) The man appears in front of a white wall with large black and yellow text celebrating a 20th anniversary, making a peace sign with his fingers while smiling towards the camera. (4) Digital AR renders of massive, detailed dragons (one red and bipedal, one green and blue with glowing horns) appear to stand within a physical exhibition hall, their heads moving as if roaring at the viewer. (5) A hand touches a large interactive horizontal display screen featuring stylized weapon icons; the screen then transitions to high-definition 3D renders of a glowing jagged sword and a hammer made of bone and scales. (6) A finger presses icons on a vertical touchscreen menu titled 'Choose a monster,' which results in the display of 3D character models wearing elaborate, color-coded samurai-style armor. (7) Close-up shots feature highly detailed physical sculptures of human characters and winged monsters with textured scales and realistic feathers, followed by a sequence of black dragon posters and lore text. (8) On a wooden table, a textured blue box and several holographic postcards depicting monster illustrations are displayed from a top-down view. (9) The woman from the intro sits in a red camping chair inside the exhibition, smiling and pumping her fist while holding a large plush prop shaped like a roasted meat bone.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man is wearing a black t-shirt with a white graphic on the chest; he has a buzz cut and a mustache. The woman wears a sleeveless black and white checkered dress with a ruffle collar.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern shopping mall with clothing displays (Versace), followed by an indoor exhibition space featuring digital walls, AR zones, interactive touchscreens, and glass display cases for figurines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A casual conversation between a male and female occurs with low ambient mall noise; the male's voice is warm and conversational while the female responds briefly. (2) The audio transitions abruptly into a rhythmic acapella vocal track where the male voice mimics drums and a bassline ('bum-bum-bum') in a steady 4/4 meter. (3) A sharp, high-frequency monster roar effect is layered over the vocal beat as a red dragon appears visually. (4) A deeper, multi-tonal growl effect occurs simultaneously with the visual appearance of a green horned monster. (5) Mechanical digital clicks and percussive 'thud' sounds trigger in sync with hand movements on the touchscreens. (6) The vocalized BGM becomes more melodic, mimicking a trumpet-like fanfare with 'pa-pa-pa' syllables over a percussive vocal base. (7) A final high-pitched 'pop' sound effect occurs as the video ends on the promotional poster.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Monster Hunter 20th Anniversary Exhibition in Taipei by showcasing interactive AR experiences, detailed merchandise, and high-quality figures in a fun, personal vlog style.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of exhibition details, locations, dates, and ticket/event information at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a unique vocal-only BGM (acapella) that mimics the game's iconic music, creating a humorous yet brand-aligned atmosphere. The fast-paced montage effectively highlights variety in the exhibition's offerings.
